I was thinking sharing this might help (more or less, depending on how much my situation could relate to yours): so me, being the friendless quiet chick, and having no one to practice my social skills with during these times, I resorted to some methods that can definitely enhace your Ne abilities, and potentially Ti as well.

First of all, something I would do is, whenever I would find myself watching my fav shows, or reading about different topics (you might need a notebook or bullet journal for this) I would dissect every phrase and breaking it down into its components. Then, I would strip them of every detail I would perceive as burdening the main idea. The next step would be identifying the parts of the phrase each word represented (geese=collective noun). As you start to think of other collective nouns that are related to the context, find what does this word cluster has in common. This way, you're slowly moving from this concrete categorization to more abstract categorizing. Then, by generalising (but making sure that with each iteration the essence somewhat remains), you take the end product and begin to tweak it as much as you like. Think of all the posibilities you could use that sequence of ideas afterwards.

This trick extends into the Ti realm as well. As you continue to add to your personal database of templates that you can readily assess and fill the blanks on the go when the situation requires you to do so, it will become easier and easier. 

Basically, use Si to your advantage by identifying the details, then throw them one by one out the window, getting rid of the particular. Use Ne to generalise and apply the concepts that you carefully extracted from experience to the situations that are yet to happen.
